title: What is computer?
subtitle: A computer is a machine that can be programmed to carry out sequences of arithmetic or logical operations automatically.
detail: A computer consists of hardware and software. The hardware includes the Physical components like the Central Processing Unit (CPU), memory (RAM), and storage devices. The software consists of instructions that tell the hardware what to do. Modern computers are electronic and digital, using binary system (0 and 1) to process vast amounts of data at incredible speeds.

title: What is Flutter?
subtitle: Flutter is an open-source UI software development toolkit created by Google.
detail: Flutter allows developers to build natively compiled applications for mobile, web, and desktop from a single codebase. It uses the Dart programming language and features 'Hot Reload', which lets you see changes in real-time without restarting the app. Flutter's widget-based architecture makes it highly customizable and efficient for creating beautiful user interfaces.

title: What is Dart?
subtitle: Dart is a client-optimized programming language for apps on multiple platforms.
detail: Dart is an object-oriented, class-based, garbage-collected language with C-style syntax. It is designed for building fast apps on any platform. Dart supports both Just-In-Time (JIT) compilation for fast development cycles and Ahead-Of-Time (AOT) compilation for high-performance production apps. It is the language that powers the Flutter framework.
